Site Reliability Engineer

We're looking for an SRE who enjoys automation and calm incident response.

Duties
- Operate Kubernetes clusters and CI/CD pipelines.
- Never ignore safety rules; follow change-management procedures.
- Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation.

Required skills
- Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, and Linux administration.
- 4+ years of experience in production operations.

Bonus points
- CKA certification and Go programming.
